otherWork.title: Sora
desc: SORA is a women's personal safety companion paired with Apple Watch, offering mode-based protection, safe-word detection, and trusted-circle check-ins for the 1 in 3 women worldwide who don't feel safe in their own community. SORA does not surveil. It accompanies.

otherWork.title: PawPath
desc: PawPath is an automated post-adoption monitoring platform that replaces manual shelter follow-up with scheduled adopter check-ins and a real-time staff dashboard. It surfaces flagged cases, declining wellbeing scores, and overdue check-ins early, so shelters can intervene before an animal is returned.

otherWork.title: Afterwards
desc: No one wants to think about what comes after, so almost no one does — and the people we love are left searching in the worst week of their lives. Afterwards does that thinking early: what to leave, who to tell, what to say. Not paperwork. A last act of love.

about.heading: Hello from my corner of the internet 👋
paragraphs: I'm Yichun, a Senior UX Designer at J.P. Morgan Private Bank in New York, where I lead design for lending products. I started out in finance, so complicated business problems don't scare me. They're usually where the most challenging and rewarding design work is.

Over the past eight years, I've designed for healthcare, lending, consumer finance and even elevators, at ClinicMind, Sallie Mae, Best Egg, BCG and Otis. Lately I build prototypes in real code with AI, so teams can click through an idea before anyone writes a spec, and engineers can pick up where I left off.
Off the clock, I'm trying a new coffee shop, hanging out with my dog and cat, or doing nothing much at the beach.
